name: @jeswr/solid-mortgage-workspace
description: Solid mortgage demo: one static site, pods in the visitor's browser, thirteen fictional organisation apps
author: Jesse Wright <63333554+jeswr@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:root && pnpm run check:packages && turbo run lint --concurrency=4
scripts.lint:root: biome check package.json turbo.json biome.json vercel.json vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts tools guardrails test test-support e2e
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm run test:video && turbo run test --concurrency=4
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && playwright test --pass-with-no-tests && turbo run test:e2e --concurrency=1
scripts.test:e2e:apps: pnpm run build && turbo run test:e2e --concurrency=1
scripts.gate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:vocab && pnpm run check:shapes && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:insignia && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
